Inside, one long refinished wooden table with fourteen different vintage wooden chairs around it (a collection of sample chairs, all different shapes), a dark switched-off flat screen with a small video bar under it on a wooden stand at the far end. Seen from inside the room, standing at one corner. Same building and same light as the reference photograph: the same white-painted brick, worn refinished maple floorboards, off-white cast-iron columns, dark timber ceiling, the same clear bright morning daylight and true colors. Natural architectural interior photograph, straight and level lines, realistic.
